scientific_integrity: The symbolic proof reduces every five-term run to two complete Pell families before any computation. The finite replay checks exactly \(50\) candidates below the cutoff using deterministic \(64\)-bit primality testing, exact factorization reconstruction, and exact divisor-sum formulas.
scientific_limitations: The global theorem gives necessary Pell-and-divisor-sum conditions for a five-term constant run, not a proof of global nonexistence. The exact finite exclusion covers starting values \(N<10^{38}\).
title: Pell rigidity at the five-term boundary for equal proper-divisor sums
